name: parse_int_list
prompt: Write a Python function named parse_int_list(text). It receives a comma-separated string. Trim whitespace around each item. Convert signed integer tokens to int. Ignore empty tokens and non-integer tokens. Return the integers in order.

name: parse_key_value_lines
prompt: Write a Python function named parse_key_value_lines(text). It receives newline-separated key=value records. Ignore blank lines and lines without exactly one equals sign. Trim keys and values. Ignore empty keys. Convert signed integer values to int; leave other values as strings. Later valid records overwrite earlier values.

name: parse_sectioned_config
prompt: Write a Python function named parse_sectioned_config(text). It receives lines of configuration text. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. A section header is [section]. Key value records inside a section use key=value and require exactly one equals sign. Trim whitespace. Ignore records before any section or with empty keys. Later valid records overwrite earlier values in the same section. Return a nested dict of section to key/value strings.
